Usage: seek <command> [flags]

Personal document search engine — BM25 + vector hybrid search

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Show version and exit.

Commands:
  add [<path>] [flags]
    Add a collection to index

  rm <name> [flags]
    Remove a collection

  collection list [flags]
    List all collections with semantic coverage

  collection show <name> [flags]
    Show detailed information for one collection

  collection rename <old> <new>
    Rename a collection (index label only; source path unchanged)

  collection reindex <name> [flags]
    Rebuild a collection from its source files

  sync [<collection>] [flags]
    Sync all collections (incremental)

  embed [flags]
    Generate embeddings (batch or realtime)

  search <query> [flags]
    Search across collections

  analyze <text> [flags]
    Analyze text (tokenize, stem)

  status [flags]
    Show index status

  service start [flags]
    Start periodic sync (with in-process embedding)

  service stop
    Stop periodic sync service

  service status
    Show service status

  hooks install [flags]
    Install seek hooks into AI tools

  hooks uninstall [flags]
    Remove seek hooks from AI tools

  hooks status
    Show installed hook health and recent activity

  hooks doctor
    Diagnose hook installation and binary resolution

  auth login
    Configure API key

  auth status
    Show auth status

  config [flags]
    Show or edit config

  advanced schema [flags]
    Show or validate schema

  advanced parsers list
    List all available parser schemas

  advanced analyze <text> [flags]
    Analyze text (tokenize, stem)

  schema [flags]
    Show or validate schema

  doctor [flags]
    Check and repair local installation (permissions)

  uninstall [flags]
    Remove seek service, hooks, cache, and config (--dry-run first)

  parsers list
    List all available parser schemas

  fields [<name>] [flags]
    Discover fast-field values and taxonomy (tags, topics, entities, etc.)

  mcp [flags]
    Run MCP (Model Context Protocol) server on stdio for AI agents

Run "seek <command> --help" for more information on a command.
